title: Magneton: Optimizing Energy Efficiency of ML Systems via Differential Energy Debugging
abstract: arXiv:2512.08365v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The training and deployment of machine learning (ML) models have become extremely energy-intensive. While existing optimization efforts focus primarily on hardware energy efficiency, a significant but overlooked source of inefficiency is software energy waste caused by poor software design. This often includes redundant or poorly designed operations that consume more energy without improving performance. These inefficiencies arise in widely used ML frameworks and applications, yet developers often lack the visibility and tools to detect and diagnose them.   We propose differential energy debugging, a novel approach that leverages the observation that competing ML systems often implement similar functionality with vastly different energy consumption. translated_title: Magneton：通过差分能量调试优化机器学习系统的能效
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）模型的训练和部署已经变得极其耗能。虽然现有的优化工作主要集中在硬件能效上，但一个重大却被忽视的低效来源是由不良软件设计导致的软件能量浪费。这通常包括冗余或设计不佳的操作，它们消耗更多能量却不能提升性能。这些低效问题广泛存在于常用的机器学习框架和应用中，然而开发者往往缺乏检测和诊断这些问题的可见性与工具。我们提出了差分能量调试这一新颖方法，它利用了这样一个观察结果：相互竞争的机器学习系统往往以截然不同的能量消耗实现类似的功能。基于这一洞察，我们设计并实现了Magneton——一个能量分析器，它在算子级别比较相似机器学习系统之间的能量消耗，并自动定位（原文在此处截断）导致能量浪费的根源。
tldr: 该论文提出“差分能量调试”新方法并实现了Magneton能量分析器，通过在算子级别比较相似机器学习系统之间的能量消耗，自动定位由不良软件设计造成的能量浪费，从而显著提升机器学习系统的能效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes differential energy debugging and implements Magneton, an energy profiler that compares energy consumption between similar ML systems at the operator level to automatically pinpoint software-induced energy waste, thereby improving the energy efficiency of ML systems.
